d: From soaring fuel prices to rising healthcare premiums and electricity bills, Americans are feeling the squeeze as the cost of living remains a major concern ahead of the midterm elections. The war in Iran is adding pressure to energy costs, while the expansion of data centres is raising fresh questions about household power bills. With Donald Trump facing low approval ratings on the economy, can his promises ease financial pressures on American families before voters head to the polls? Cary Johnston brings you the details on Firstpost America. James Gooderson reports for Firstpost from…
